title: Audit log: emit model change events + internal admin query endpoints
author: Svetlana Petrenko
description:
Problem: Support/Security need authoritative, queryable audit history for model metadata changes (create/update/promote/deprecate/rollback) to answer enterprise escalations (e.g., “what changed, who did it, when, and in which deployment?”) and to satisfy audit/retention expectations for Private/VPC. Today we emit some control-plane events for changelog generation, but they’re not shaped as audit events, not consistently retained, and there’s no internal support surface to query by model/version/workspace.

This PR adds (1) first-class audit log events for model metadata and promotion lifecycle, and (2) an internal admin-only query API used by Support/Compliance to retrieve the audit timeline. Customer-visible release notes remain generated elsewhere; this is the compliance/support trace.

Scope:
- Emit audit events on: model_version.created, model_version.metadata_updated, model_version.promoted, model_version.deprecated, model_version.rollback_initiated, model_version.rollback_completed.
- Ensure events include actor + request context (service/user), are redact-safe (no internal-only fields leak), and are linkable to model IDs/version IDs.
- Add internal admin endpoints to query audit history with pagination and filters; gated behind RBAC permission `auditlog:read:model_changes` and additionally `admin_only=true` (no customer roles).
- Wire audit events into the existing AuditLog pipeline (retention, SIEM export) with a dedicated event namespace `model_registry.*`.

Non-goals:
- Customer subscriptions/notifications.
- Rewriting historical events (we’ll have partial backfill in a follow-up; this PR is forward-looking).

Event contract (high level):
- `event_type`: one of the above
- `event_id`: UUID (idempotency keyed by (request_id, event_type, object_id))
- `timestamp`
- `actor`: {type=user|service, id, email (if user), service_name (if service)}
- `workspace_id` (nullable for internal catalog ops)
- `object`: {kind=model_version, model_id, model_slug, version_id, version_semver}
- `deployment_context`: {hosted|dedicated|private, region (optional), private_cluster_id (optional)}
- `change_summary`: human-readable, redaction-safe summary
- `diff`: stored as internal-only JSON in the audit store; API returns a redacted view unless caller has `auditlog:read:model_changes_internal`

Admin API:
- GET /internal/admin/audit/model-changes?model_id=&version_id=&workspace_id=&event_type=&after=&limit=
- GET /internal/admin/audit/model-changes/{event_id}
Both endpoints are available only to `RedwoodEmployee` principals and service accounts in the `support-tooling` group.

Notes on redaction:
- We never include `internal_notes`, `embargo_reason`, or raw metadata blobs in the default response.
- For internal security/compliance roles, we return a structured `diff_preview` containing only approved fields (field allowlist).

Follow-ups:
- Add UI in Support Admin (separate PR) + docs/runbook for incident responders.
- Backfill best-effort events for the last 30 days using changelog generator store.

Refs:
- Linear: ENG-9828 (audit log events for model metadata changes), ENG-9825 (redaction rules)
- Jira: INT-11903 (support admin access request), SUP-28429 (customer reports output regression after silent model change)
- Related PRs: pr-18435 (control-plane change events), pr-18447 (console APIs), pr-18452 (CI preview), pr-18441 (generator templates)

Checklist:
- [x] Security review requested (Marcus)
- [x] RBAC policy updated + tests
- [x] Event payloads validated against audit schema
- [x] Load test: 1k events/min sustained for 10 min w/ no dropped events
- [x] Runbook snippet added to internal docs (link in comments)
- [x] Metrics + alerts added for event ingestion lag
commits: auditlog: add model_registry event namespace + schema registration
control-plane: emit model_version.* audit events on create/update/promote/deprecate/rollback
authz: add auditlog:read:model_changes and auditlog:read:model_changes_internal permissions
admin api: internal endpoints for querying model change audit history (pagination + filters)
tests: redaction allowlist tests + RBAC integration tests
obs: metrics for audit event emit failures + ingestion lag dashboard hooks
testing: Unit: added tests for event emission (incl. idempotency behavior) and redaction allowlist. Integration: RBAC-gated access to /internal/admin/audit/model-changes; verifies non-admin RedwoodEmployee is denied and support-tooling service account is allowed. Manual: replayed a promote + rollback flow in staging; verified audit events appear in AuditLog store and are retrievable via admin endpoint; verified internal-only fields are omitted from default response.
review_conversation:
Marcus Lin (Security): Please confirm we’re not returning raw metadata blobs via the admin endpoints, and that internal-only fields are impossible to access without the explicit internal permission. Also add a note about retention/SIEM export behavior. 

Svetlana Petrenko (Author): Updated the handler to return a redacted `diff_preview` by default (allowlist), and moved raw `diff` behind `auditlog:read:model_changes_internal`. Added tests to ensure `internal_notes` and `embargo_reason` are never returned. Added an internal doc note that events flow through existing retention and SIEM export pipelines; no new storage class.

Naomi Feldman (Compliance): Please add workspace_id semantics for catalog-wide changes (e.g., hosted public catalog). We need it nullable but explicit in the contract. 

Svetlana Petrenko (Author): Added `workspace_id: null` for internal catalog ops; `workspace_scope` field set to `global_catalog` vs `customer_workspace`. Included in schema and docs.

Ethan Park (Control Plane): Concern about emitting audit events from hot paths; please ensure failures don’t block promotions. Also add metrics for emit failures and drop counts. 

Svetlana Petrenko (Author): Emission is best-effort (non-blocking). If the audit pipeline is unavailable, we enqueue to the local outbox and proceed; we emit `auditlog_emit_failed_total` and log at WARN with request_id + model_version identifiers.

Dev Patel (Support): Can we filter by model_slug and semver in addition to IDs? That’s what support usually has in tickets. 

Svetlana Petrenko (Author): Added optional filters `model_slug` and `version_semver` (backed by indexed columns). Included in the endpoint docs and tests.

Chloe Martin (Console): Please ensure the internal endpoints are clearly separated from customer-facing APIs and won’t be accidentally wired into Console. 

Svetlana Petrenko (Author): Endpoints are under /internal/admin and require RedwoodEmployee principal + permission; also excluded from public OpenAPI. Added routing guard and a comment in the controller.

Approvals: Marcus Lin (Security) approved after changes. Naomi Feldman approved. Ethan Park approved. Dev Patel approved.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge behind feature flag `auditlog_model_changes_v1` default off. 2) Enable in staging for 48h and monitor audit ingestion lag + emit failure metrics. 3) Enable in prod for 10% of control-plane pods (config rollout) for 24h; confirm event volume and SIEM export correctness. 4) Ramp to 100% and announce availability to Support/Compliance; grant RBAC to support-tooling group (tracked in INT-11903).
release_notes: Internal: Added model change audit events (create/update/promote/deprecate/rollback) and admin-only query endpoints for Support/Compliance. No customer-facing behavior change.
notes: This PR intentionally does not expose audit queries to customer tenants. The admin surface is restricted to RedwoodEmployee principals and designated service accounts, and responses are redacted by default.
